test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

Unskilled workers are being replaced by trained people in this factory.

options.text: Trained people have replaced unskilled workers in this factory.
Unskilled workers are replacing trained people in this factory.
Trained people were replacing unskilled workers in this factory.
Trained people are replacing unskilled workers in this factory.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Trained people are replacing unskilled workers in this factory."**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The basic structure of these types of sentences:​

 
 
• **Sub. + is/are/am + V-ing + Prep. + Ob. **(active voice)
 
• **Sub. (Ob. of Active) + is/are/am + being + V****3** (passive voice)
 
 
 
• ​Look at an example:
 
 
• They are doing multiple jobs.
 
• Multiple jobs **are being** done by them.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *Trained people are replacing unskilled workers in this factory.*
